about.title: About Speed Duel GX: Duelists of Shadows
paragraphs: Speed Duel GX: Duelists of Shadows is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG pack released on 30 March 2023, in the SEVENS & GO RUSH!! era. It has 220 cards, and with the 25 other rarities there are 245 to collect in all.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 220 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 245, adding the 25 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
